posts.title: Introducing Pattern Panic
posts.description: The story of Pattern Panic, a sliding tile puzzle that crosses the sliding picture game with a Rubik's Cube, from a pygame prototype to an installable web game built with PixiJS and AI.

posts.title: Introducing Trolay
posts.description: A smarter way to manage your shopping budget. Scan items as you shop, track your spending in real time, avoid checkout surprises and keep control of your spending. No downloads, no account required, and works offline.

posts.title: More humans less machines
posts.description: In a world where AI is taking over the creative industry, we need more human interactions
